name: Jan Prusimski

events.note: Died childless; alive on 24 May 1737. The Teki regest says 1740.
With his brothers, heir of their father Krzysztof's estates, Trąbczyn among them, held undivided until the brothers' division of 1740.

notes: Not Jan na Kolno: the database's sw.33424 is this Jan, Krzysztof's son.
